company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform designed for building and using APIs, simplifying each step of the API lifecycle. It enables engineers and organizations to develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services, streamlining collaboration for faster creation.
target_audience: Postman is built for engineers, including individuals, teams, and enterprises, involved in building, testing, managing, and distributing APIs. It serves solo developers, collaborative teams, and large organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, seeking to scale and govern their API operations.

company_overview: Supabase provides an open-source backend-as-a-service platform that offers a Postgres database, authentication, data APIs, edge functions, realtime data, storage, and vector embeddings. It serves as a complete Postgres developer platform designed to help users build and scale applications, particularly for AI-built applications and innovation teams.
target_audience: The platform is built for developers, including citizen developers, engineers, and non-technical consultants, who are building applications, especially high-performance SaaS and AI-built applications. It caters to startups, innovation teams, and enterprises looking for production-ready backend infrastructure.

company_overview: Vapi provides a unified, API-native platform for building, testing, and deploying AI voice agents at scale. It handles infrastructure, orchestration, and real-time monitoring, enabling businesses to configure voice and conversation flows rapidly.
target_audience: Vapi targets enterprises, including Fortune 100 companies, and developers looking to deploy AI voice agents. Its pricing tiers also cater to builders and early teams, scaling teams in production, and sophisticated organizations.
